name: manual_0afc8c
claim: Before acting on a repo, verify you are not on a stale branch: fetch and compare the local HEAD tree to origin (tree-twin, not ahead/behind counts), and adopt upstream structural migrations before writing.

decisions.notes: 2026-06-22: I committed into the dead '.agents/memory' dir while origin/main had already migrated the memory system to '.agent/'. I was outdated and did not know it because I never checked origin before writing.
